capital.zh: 罗马（后期另有君士坦丁堡）

summary.en: The empire founded when Octavian became Augustus in 27 BCE ruled the whole Mediterranean world, from Britain to Egypt and the edge of Mesopotamia. This record ends with the lasting division between eastern and western courts after the death of Theodosius I in 395.
summary.zh: 公元前27年屋大维获封“奥古斯都”，罗马帝国由此建立，统治从不列颠到埃及、直至美索不达米亚边缘的整个地中海世界。395年狄奥多西一世死后帝国东西两部永久分治，本条目止于此。

sources.title: The Cambridge Ancient History, vols. X–XIII (2nd ed.)

summary.en: The western half of the Roman Empire, governed from Milan and after 402 from Ravenna, lost Britain, Spain, Gaul and Africa to Germanic peoples during the 5th century. It ended when Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus in 476.
summary.zh: 罗马帝国的西半部，先以米兰、402年后以拉文纳为都，5世纪间相继将不列颠、西班牙、高卢和北非丧于日耳曼诸族。476年奥多亚克废黜罗慕路斯·奥古斯都路斯，西罗马帝国灭亡。

name.zh: 罗慕路斯·奥古斯都路斯

sources.title: Peter Heather, The Fall of the Roman Empire: A New History (2005)

summary.en: The eastern Roman Empire, Greek-speaking and Orthodox Christian, ruled from Constantinople for more than a thousand years. It reconquered much of the West under Justinian, lost the Levant and Egypt to the Arabs, revived under the Macedonian dynasty, and fell to the Ottomans in 1453.
summary.zh: 东罗马帝国以希腊语和东正教为特征，以君士坦丁堡为都延续千余年。查士丁尼时期收复西部大片领土，后将黎凡特和埃及丧于阿拉伯人，马其顿王朝时复兴，1453年亡于奥斯曼帝国。

name.zh: 阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁
君士坦丁十一世·巴列奥略

sources.title: Judith Herrin, Byzantium: The Surprising Life of a Medieval Empire (2007)

note: Constantinople was held by the Latin Empire 1204–1261; Michael VIII ruled from Nicaea from 1259 and recovered the city in 1261.

summary.en: Settled in Aquitaine by Roman treaty in 418, the Visigoths built a kingdom centred first on Toulouse and, after their defeat by the Franks in 507, on Toledo in Hispania. Reccared's conversion from Arianism to Catholicism in 587 unified the realm, which fell to the Umayyad conquest in 711.
summary.zh: 西哥特人于418年依罗马条约定居阿基坦，先以图卢兹为中心建立王国，507年败于法兰克人后转以伊比利亚的托莱多为中心。587年国王雷卡雷德由阿里乌派改宗天主教，王国得以统一，711年亡于倭马亚王朝的征服。

note: Wikidata gives 476–718; this record uses the foedus of 418 and the Umayyad conquest of 711 (Septimania held out until c. 720).

capital.zh: 巴黎（墨洛温王朝）；亚琛（加洛林王朝）

summary.en: The kingdom of the Franks, united by the Merovingian Clovis I, became the dominant power of western Europe. Under the Carolingians Charles Martel, Pepin the Short and Charlemagne it grew into an empire stretching from the Pyrenees to the Elbe, divided among Charlemagne's grandsons at Verdun in 843.
summary.zh: 法兰克王国由墨洛温王朝的克洛维一世统一，成为西欧最强大的势力。在加洛林家族的查理·马特、矮子丕平和查理曼治下，它发展为从比利牛斯山延伸至易北河的帝国，843年在凡尔登由查理曼的孙辈瓜分。

sources.title: Gregory of Tours, History of the Franks
Rosamond McKitterick, Charlemagne: The Formation of a European Identity (2008)

capital.en: No fixed capital (Habsburg court at Vienna in later centuries)
capital.zh: 无固定首都（后期哈布斯堡宫廷驻维也纳）

summary.en: A complex of kingdoms, principalities, bishoprics and free cities in central Europe under an elected emperor, crowned by the pope from Otto I to Charles V (1530). From 1438 the title was held almost continuously by the Habsburgs; weakened by the Reformation and the Thirty Years' War, the empire was dissolved by Francis II under pressure from Napoleon.
summary.zh: 神圣罗马帝国是中欧由诸王国、公国、主教领地和自由城市组成的复合体，由选举产生的皇帝统领，自奥托一世至查理五世（1530年）皇帝均由教宗加冕。1438年后帝位几乎一直由哈布斯堡家族掌握；帝国经宗教改革和三十年战争而衰弱，1806年在拿破仑压力下由弗朗茨二世宣布解散。

sources.title: Peter H. Wilson, Heart of Europe: A History of the Holy Roman Empire (2016)

note: Some histories begin the empire with Charlemagne's coronation in 800; Wikidata and most modern works date it from Otto I's coronation in 962. Ruler dates are imperial reigns (election to death/abdication).

capital.zh: 伦敦（1066年前温切斯特亦为重要王都）

summary.en: Formed when Æthelstan of Wessex took Viking-ruled Northumbria in 927, England was conquered by Cnut in 1016 and by the Normans in 1066. It absorbed Wales in the 16th century, shared a monarch with Scotland from 1603 and united with it as Great Britain in 1707.
summary.zh: 927年威塞克斯国王埃塞尔斯坦夺取维京人统治的诺森布里亚，英格兰王国由此形成；1016年被克努特征服，1066年又被诺曼人征服。16世纪它兼并威尔士，1603年起与苏格兰共戴一君，1707年两国合并为大不列颠。

note: Wikidata notes a republican interregnum (1649–1660) within this span.

summary.en: Created by the Acts of Union between England and Scotland in 1707, Great Britain became Europe's leading naval and commercial power, winning the Seven Years' War but losing thirteen American colonies. It merged with the Kingdom of Ireland on 1 January 1801.
summary.zh: 1707年英格兰与苏格兰依《联合法令》合并为大不列颠王国，成为欧洲首屈一指的海上和商业强国，赢得七年战争，却失去了北美十三殖民地。1801年1月1日它与爱尔兰王国合并。

sources.title: Union with Scotland Act 1706 / Union with England Act 1707

summary.en: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, formed in 1801, led the Industrial Revolution and ruled the largest empire in history. After most of Ireland left in 1922 it became the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, fought on the winning side in both world wars and decolonised after 1945.
summary.zh: 1801年成立的大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国引领工业革命，统治了史上最庞大的帝国。1922年爱尔兰大部分地区独立后，它改称大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国，两次世界大战均属战胜方，1945年后逐步去殖民化。

note: Wikidata dates the present UK (with Northern Ireland) from 1921–22; this record runs from the 1801 union with Ireland. 'to' 2025 means still existing.

summary.en: From the election of Hugh Capet in 987, Capetian, Valois and Bourbon kings gradually extended royal power over the great fiefs to build Europe's most populous state. Royal absolutism peaked under Louis XIV; the Revolution abolished the monarchy in 1792.
summary.zh: 自987年于格·卡佩当选国王起，卡佩、瓦卢瓦和波旁王朝的国王逐步将王权扩展至各大封建领地，建立了欧洲人口最多的国家。路易十四时期专制王权达于顶峰，1792年大革命废除了君主制。

sources.title: Colin Jones, The Cambridge Illustrated History of France (1994)

note: Wikidata ends the item on 4 September 1791 (start of the constitutional monarchy); the monarchy was abolished on 21 September 1792.

name.zh: 科尔多瓦哈里发国（后倭马亚王朝）

summary.en: Abd al-Rahman III, Umayyad emir of al-Andalus, proclaimed himself caliph in 929, making Córdoba one of the largest and most cultured cities of Europe. After the de facto rule of the chamberlain Almanzor, civil war from 1009 broke the caliphate into rival taifa kingdoms by 1031.
summary.zh: 安达卢斯的倭马亚埃米尔阿卜杜拉赫曼三世于929年自称哈里发，使科尔多瓦成为欧洲最大、文化最繁盛的城市之一。经过宰相曼苏尔的实际专权后，1009年起的内战使哈里发国至1031年分裂为相互对立的泰法诸王国。

name.zh: 曼苏尔（宰相，实际掌权者）

sources.title: Hugh Kennedy, Muslim Spain and Portugal: A Political History of al-Andalus (1996)

summary.en: A federation of East Slavic principalities under the Rurikid dynasty, centred on Kyiv after Oleg took the city around 882. It adopted Byzantine Christianity in 988, flourished under Yaroslav the Wise, fragmented into rival principalities in the 12th century and was overrun by the Mongols in 1237–1240.
summary.zh: 基辅罗斯是留里克王朝治下的东斯拉夫诸公国联合体，约882年奥列格夺取基辅后以此为中心。988年接受拜占庭基督教，智者雅罗斯拉夫时期达于鼎盛，12世纪分裂为相互竞争的诸公国，1237—1240年被蒙古征服。

name.zh: 弗拉基米尔二世·莫诺马赫

sources.title: Simon Franklin and Jonathan Shepard, The Emergence of Rus 750–1200 (1996)

note: Early dates (882, Oleg, Igor) rest on the Primary Chronicle and are partly traditional.

summary.en: A small appanage given to Daniel, son of Alexander Nevsky, Moscow grew as a tax-collecting ally of the Golden Horde. Dmitry Donskoy defeated the Horde at Kulikovo in 1380; Ivan III ended tribute in 1480 and gathered the Russian lands, and in 1547 Ivan IV was crowned tsar.
summary.zh: 莫斯科原是亚历山大·涅夫斯基之子达尼尔的小块封地，作为金帐汗国的代征税者而日渐壮大。1380年德米特里·顿斯科伊在库里科沃击败金帐汗国；伊凡三世于1480年摆脱纳贡并统一罗斯诸地，1547年伊凡四世加冕为沙皇。

capital.zh: 莫斯科（1712年起为圣彼得堡）

summary.en: Beginning with Ivan IV's coronation as tsar, Muscovite Russia conquered Kazan and Astrakhan and expanded across Siberia. After the Time of Troubles the Romanov dynasty took the throne in 1613; Peter I transformed the state and proclaimed it the Russian Empire in 1721.
summary.zh: 自伊凡四世加冕为沙皇起，俄罗斯沙皇国征服喀山和阿斯特拉罕，并向西伯利亚全境扩张。“混乱时期”之后，罗曼诺夫王朝于1613年登上王位；彼得一世全面改造国家，并于1721年宣布其为俄罗斯帝国。

sources.title: Paul Bushkovitch, A Concise History of Russia (2011)

summary.en: Proclaimed by Peter the Great after victory over Sweden, the Russian Empire stretched from the Baltic and Black Sea to the Pacific and Alaska. It defeated Napoleon, abolished serfdom in 1861 and industrialised late; strained by the First World War, the monarchy fell in the February Revolution of 1917.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯帝国由彼得大帝在战胜瑞典后宣布建立，疆域从波罗的海和黑海延伸至太平洋和阿拉斯加。它击败拿破仑，1861年废除农奴制，工业化起步较晚；第一次世界大战使其不堪重负，君主制在1917年二月革命中被推翻。

sources.title: Dominic Lieven (ed.), The Cambridge History of Russia, vol. 2: Imperial Russia, 1689–1917 (2006)

summary.en: The Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, formed by Bolshevik-ruled republics in 1922, was a one-party communist state that industrialised under Stalin at enormous human cost. It bore the heaviest losses in defeating Nazi Germany, rivalled the United States as a superpower in the Cold War and dissolved in 1991.
summary.zh: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟于1922年由布尔什维克统治的各共和国组成，是一党执政的共产主义国家，在斯大林治下以巨大的人的代价实现工业化。它在打败纳粹德国的战争中承受了最惨重的损失，冷战中与美国并列为超级大国，1991年解体。

sources.title: Ronald Grigor Suny, The Soviet Experiment (1998)

note: Leaders listed by de facto paramount leadership; Stalin was General Secretary from 1922 and consolidated power after Lenin's death in 1924.

summary.en: Under the Spanish Habsburgs, from Charles I (Emperor Charles V) to Charles II, the Spanish monarchy ruled Castile and Aragon, much of Italy, the Low Countries and a vast American empire, and Portugal from 1580 to 1640. Its silver-financed hegemony faded in the 17th century, and Charles II's childless death led to the War of the Spanish Succession.
summary.zh: 在西班牙哈布斯堡王朝治下（从查理一世即查理五世皇帝到卡洛斯二世），西班牙君主国统治卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡、意大利大部、尼德兰以及广袤的美洲帝国，1580至1640年间还兼领葡萄牙。依靠美洲白银支撑的霸权在17世纪逐渐衰落，卡洛斯二世无嗣而终，引发了西班牙王位继承战争。

name.zh: 卡洛斯一世（即查理五世）
哈布斯堡君主国（奥地利）

summary.en: The union of the Austrian, Bohemian and Hungarian crowns under the House of Habsburg began in 1526, when Ferdinand I inherited Bohemia and Hungary after the Battle of Mohács. Proclaimed the Austrian Empire in 1804 and reorganised as Austria-Hungary in 1867, the multinational monarchy broke apart at the end of the First World War.
summary.zh: 1526年莫哈奇战役后斐迪南一世继承波希米亚和匈牙利王位，奥地利、波希米亚、匈牙利诸王冠由此在哈布斯堡家族治下联合。1804年改称奥地利帝国，1867年重组为奥匈帝国，这个多民族君主国在第一次世界大战结束时解体。

sources.title: Pieter M. Judson, The Habsburg Empire: A New History (2016)

note: Wikidata's description spans 1282–1918 for Habsburg rule in Austria; its start date (1526) marks the composite monarchy used here.

summary.en: Created by the Union of Lublin, the Commonwealth was an elective monarchy in which a powerful noble parliament, the Sejm, limited royal power. Once among Europe's largest states and known for religious tolerance, it was weakened by wars and the liberum veto and partitioned out of existence by Russia, Prussia and Austria in 1772–1795.
summary.zh: 波兰—立陶宛联邦依《卢布林联合》建立，实行选举君主制，强大的贵族议会（瑟姆）限制王权。它一度是欧洲面积最大的国家之一，并以宗教宽容著称，后因战争和“自由否决权”而衰弱，1772至1795年间被俄、普、奥三国瓜分殆尽。

name.zh: 齐格蒙特二世·奥古斯特
斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基

sources.title: Norman Davies, God's Playground: A History of Poland, vol. 1 (1981)

summary.en: A maritime republic led by an elected doge, Venice grew rich on trade between Europe and the Levant and built a chain of colonies across the Adriatic and eastern Mediterranean. It played a leading role in the Fourth Crusade, later declined as Atlantic trade rose, and surrendered to Napoleon in 1797.
summary.zh: 威尼斯是由选举产生的总督领导的海上共和国，凭借欧洲与黎凡特之间的贸易致富，在亚得里亚海和东地中海建立了一系列殖民据点。它在第四次十字军东征中扮演主导角色，后随大西洋贸易兴起而衰落，1797年向拿破仑投降。

name.zh: 彼得罗二世·奥尔赛奥洛

sources.title: Frederic C. Lane, Venice: A Maritime Republic (1973)

note: 697 is the traditional date of the first doge; reliable records begin in the 8th century.

summary.en: Elector Frederick III of Brandenburg crowned himself King Frederick I in Prussia at Königsberg in 1701. Built on a strong army and bureaucracy, Prussia rose to great-power status under Frederick the Great and, under Wilhelm I and Bismarck, unified Germany in 1871; the monarchy ended in the revolution of 1918.
summary.zh: 1701年勃兰登堡选帝侯腓特烈三世在柯尼斯堡加冕为“在普鲁士的国王”腓特烈一世。普鲁士依靠强大的军队和官僚体系，在腓特烈大王治下跻身列强，又在威廉一世和俾斯麦领导下于1871年统一德意志；1918年革命终结了君主制。

name.zh: 腓特烈二世（腓特烈大王）

sources.title: Christopher Clark, Iron Kingdom: The Rise and Downfall of Prussia, 1600–1947 (2006)

summary.en: A federal monarchy of German states under the King of Prussia as emperor, proclaimed at Versailles in January 1871. It became an industrial and scientific leader and built a colonial empire, but defeat in the First World War brought revolution and the abdication of Wilhelm II in November 1918.
summary.zh: 德意志帝国是以普鲁士国王为皇帝的德意志各邦联邦君主国，1871年1月在凡尔赛宣告成立。它成为工业和科学的领先者并建立了殖民帝国，但在第一次世界大战中战败，引发革命，威廉二世于1918年11月退位。

note: Wikidata dates the empire from 1 January 1871 (the new constitution); the imperial proclamation was on 18 January 1871.

summary.en: Proclaimed in 1861 under the House of Savoy, the kingdom completed unification with Venetia (1866) and Rome (1870). Victor Emmanuel III appointed Mussolini prime minister in 1922; after defeat in the Second World War, a referendum in 1946 replaced the monarchy with a republic.
summary.zh: 意大利王国于1861年在萨伏依王室治下宣告成立，1866年并入威尼托、1870年并入罗马，完成统一。1922年维克托·伊曼纽尔三世任命墨索里尼为首相；第二次世界大战战败后，1946年全民公决以共和制取代君主制。

sources.title: Christopher Duggan, The Force of Destiny: A History of Italy since 1796 (2007)

summary.en: Kingdom founded in Italy by Theodoric the Great after he defeated Odoacer, ruling a Roman population through Roman institutions while the Gothic army stayed Arian. Justinian's Gothic War (535–554) destroyed it.
summary.zh: 狄奥多里克大帝击败奥多亚克后在意大利建立的王国，沿用罗马制度治理罗马居民，哥特军队则信奉阿里乌派。查士丁尼发动的哥特战争（535—554年）使其覆灭。

name.zh: 阿玛拉逊莎（摄政，后为女王）

sources.title: Procopius, History of the Wars, Books V–VIII (Gothic War)

note: Teia fell at Mons Lactarius in late 552 or 553; Gothic resistance continued in pockets until 554/562.

summary.en: Germanic kingdom founded when Alboin led the Lombards into Italy in 568, leaving the peninsula divided between Lombard and Byzantine lands for two centuries. Its kings issued written laws (Rothari's Edict, 643) and were finally conquered by Charlemagne in 774.
summary.zh: 568年阿尔博因率伦巴第人进入意大利后建立的日耳曼王国，此后两个世纪半岛分属伦巴第与拜占庭。其国王颁布成文法（643年《罗塔里敕令》），774年被查理曼征服。

sources.title: Chris Wickham, Early Medieval Italy: Central Power and Local Society 400–1000 (1981)

note: Pavia became the royal seat after its capture in 572; the interregnum of the dukes (574–584) is left out of the ruler list.

summary.en: Kingdom of the West Saxons in southern England. Under Alfred the Great it alone survived the Viking Great Army, and his son and grandson extended its rule until Æthelstan became the first king of all England in 927.
summary.zh: 英格兰南部西撒克逊人的王国。在阿尔弗雷德大王治下，它是唯一抵挡住维京“大军”的王国；其子与其孙不断扩张，927年埃塞尔斯坦成为全英格兰的第一位国王。

name.zh: 塞尔迪克（传说中的开国者）

sources.title: Barbara Yorke, Wessex in the Early Middle Ages (1995)

note: The 519 founding under Cerdic comes from the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle and is traditional; Winchester became the main royal centre only from the 7th century.

summary.en: The western share of the Carolingian Empire given to Charles the Bald at Verdun in 843, ancestor of France. Viking raids and powerful counts weakened its kings; Carolingians and Robertians alternated on the throne until Hugh Capet was elected in 987.
summary.zh: 843年《凡尔登条约》分给秃头查理的加洛林帝国西部，是法国的前身。维京人的劫掠和强大的伯爵削弱了王权；加洛林家族与罗贝尔家族交替称王，直到987年于格·卡佩当选。

sources.title: Jim Bradbury, The Capetians: Kings of France 987–1328 (2007)

note: The kingdom had no fixed capital; Laon was the last Carolingians' chief stronghold, Paris the Robertians' base.

capital.zh: 雷根斯堡（主要王室驻地）

summary.en: The eastern share of the Carolingian Empire assigned to Louis the German in 843. After the Carolingian line died out in 911 the dukes elected Conrad I and then the Saxon Henry the Fowler, whose son Otto I was crowned emperor in 962.
summary.zh: 843年分给日耳曼人路易的加洛林帝国东部。911年加洛林世系断绝后，诸公爵先后推举康拉德一世和萨克森的捕鸟者亨利为王，其子奥托一世于962年加冕为皇帝。

sources.title: Timothy Reuter, Germany in the Early Middle Ages c. 800–1056 (1991)

note: Itinerant kingship: Regensburg was Louis the German's and Arnulf's favourite palace; the Ottonians favoured Saxony (Magdeburg, Quedlinburg). Charles the Fat ruled Alemannia from 876 and all East Francia from 882.

summary.en: Independent Umayyad state in al-Andalus founded by Abd al-Rahman I, a refugee from the Abbasid overthrow of his family. Its emirs built the Great Mosque of Córdoba and fought rebels and Christian kingdoms until Abd al-Rahman III declared a caliphate in 929.
summary.zh: 由逃过阿拔斯王朝屠杀的倭马亚王子阿卜杜·拉赫曼一世在安达卢斯建立的独立国家。历代埃米尔修建科尔多瓦大清真寺，并与叛乱者和北方基督教王国作战，929年阿卜杜·拉赫曼三世改称哈里发。

sources.title: Hugh Kennedy, Muslim Spain and Portugal (1996)
Roger Collins, Caliphs and Kings: Spain, 796–1031 (2012)

summary.en: Last Muslim state in Iberia, founded by Muhammad I ibn al-Ahmar and long a tributary of Castile. The Nasrids built the Alhambra; dynastic feuds and the war waged by Ferdinand and Isabella ended in Muhammad XII's surrender of Granada on 2 January 1492.
summary.zh: 伊比利亚最后的穆斯林国家，由穆罕默德一世（伊本·艾哈迈尔）建立，长期向卡斯蒂利亚纳贡。奈斯尔王朝修建了阿尔罕布拉宫；王室内斗与费尔南多、伊莎贝拉发动的战争最终使穆罕默德十二世于1492年1月2日献出格拉纳达。

story.en:
Muhammad ibn al-Ahmar proclaimed himself ruler at Arjona in 1232 and took Granada in 1238, just as Castile was swallowing Córdoba and Seville. He survived by becoming Ferdinand III's vassal and even sent troops to help besiege Muslim Seville in 1248. For the next two and a half centuries his heirs balanced between Castile and the Marinids of Morocco, paying tribute in gold.

The kingdom's wealth went into the Alhambra. Yusuf I and Muhammad V built most of the palaces visitors see today, including the Court of the Lions, and covered their walls with poems by the court vizier Ibn Zamrak.

From 1482 a civil war between Abu l-Hasan Ali, his brother al-Zagal and his son Muhammad XII (Boabdil) gave Ferdinand and Isabella their chance. After ten years of sieges Boabdil handed over the keys on 2 January 1492. A later legend has his mother taunting him as he looked back at the city from the pass still called "the Moor's last sigh".
story.zh:
穆罕默德·伊本·艾哈迈尔于1232年在阿尔霍纳自立，1238年攻取格拉纳达，恰逢卡斯蒂利亚吞并科尔多瓦与塞维利亚之际。他靠向费尔南多三世称臣得以存续，1248年甚至派兵协助围攻穆斯林的塞维利亚。此后两个半世纪，其继承者在卡斯蒂利亚与摩洛哥马林王朝之间周旋，以黄金纳贡。

王国的财富大多投入阿尔罕布拉宫。尤素福一世和穆罕默德五世修建了今日游客所见的大部分宫殿，包括狮子院，宫墙上镌刻着宫廷维齐尔伊本·赞拉克的诗句。

1482年起，阿布·哈桑·阿里、其弟扎加勒与其子穆罕默德十二世（布阿卜迪勒）之间的内战给了费尔南多和伊莎贝拉可乘之机。经过十年围攻，布阿卜迪勒于1492年1月2日交出城门钥匙。后世传说他在山口回望故城时遭母亲讥讽，那处山口至今仍称“摩尔人最后的叹息”。

name.zh: 穆罕默德十二世（布阿卜迪勒）

sources.title: L. P. Harvey, Islamic Spain, 1250 to 1500 (1990)

note: Muhammad I's rule began at Arjona in 1232; Granada itself was taken in 1238 (Wikidata's start). Muhammad V was deposed 1359–1362. Wikidata labels Boabdil's item (Q312763) "Muhammad XI" under an older numbering; most modern works call him Muhammad XII. His reign was interrupted in 1483–1487.

summary.en: Kingdom formed when Ferdinand I of León left Castile to his son Sancho II in 1065. Usually joined with León, it led the advance south: Alfonso VI took Toledo in 1085 and Alfonso VIII won at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212. Ferdinand III united it permanently with León in 1230.
summary.zh: 1065年莱昂国王费尔南多一世将卡斯蒂利亚传给其子桑乔二世而形成的王国。它常与莱昂合一，是南进的主力：阿方索六世于1085年攻取托莱多，阿方索八世于1212年在托洛萨会战获胜。1230年费尔南多三世使之与莱昂永久合并。

sources.title: Joseph F. O'Callaghan, A History of Medieval Spain (1975)
Bernard F. Reilly, The Medieval Spains (1993)

capital.zh: 托莱多、巴利亚多利德（流动宫廷）

summary.en: The union of Castile and León under Ferdinand III, who went on to conquer Córdoba and Seville. It grew into the largest Iberian realm; Isabella I's marriage to Ferdinand of Aragon joined it with the Crown of Aragon, and in 1516 both passed to the Habsburg Charles I.
summary.zh: 费尔南多三世治下卡斯蒂利亚与莱昂的联合体，他随后征服科尔多瓦与塞维利亚。它成为伊比利亚最大的王国；伊莎贝拉一世与阿拉贡的费尔南多联姻使之与阿拉贡王室结合，1516年二者均传给哈布斯堡的卡洛斯一世。

sources.title: Teofilo F. Ruiz, Spain's Centuries of Crisis: 1300–1474 (2007)

note: Wikidata dates the Crown of Castile to 1715 (Nueva Planta). This record stops in 1516, when polity-habsburg-spain takes over the succession band. Joanna remained nominal queen until 1555.

summary.en: Composite monarchy born from the betrothal of Petronilla of Aragon to Ramon Berenguer IV of Barcelona in 1137. It conquered Majorca and Valencia, built a Mediterranean empire in Sicily, Sardinia and Naples, and kept its own laws and Cortes until the Nueva Planta decrees (1707–1716).
summary.zh: 1137年阿拉贡女继承人佩特罗尼拉与巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世订婚而形成的复合君主国。它征服马略卡与巴伦西亚，在西西里、撒丁和那不勒斯建立地中海帝国，并保有自己的法律与议会，直到《新基本法令》（1707—1716年）。

sources.title: T. N. Bisson, The Medieval Crown of Aragon: A Short History (1986)
J. H. Elliott, The Revolt of the Catalans (1963)

note: No single capital: the count-kings ruled from Barcelona, were crowned at Zaragoza and also resided in Valencia. The end date follows the Nueva Planta decree for Catalonia (1716); Wikidata gives 1715.

summary.en: Kingdom proclaimed by Afonso Henriques after the battle of Ourique (1139). It completed its reconquest in 1249, opened the sea route to India under the Avis kings, was ruled from Madrid 1580–1640, and fell to a republican revolution in 1910.
summary.zh: 奥里克战役（1139年）后阿方索·恩里克斯宣布建立的王国。它于1249年完成收复失地，在阿维斯王朝治下开辟通往印度的海路，1580—1640年受马德里统治，1910年被共和革命推翻。

sources.title: A. H. de Oliveira Marques, History of Portugal (1972)
David Birmingham, A Concise History of Portugal (2003)

note: Coimbra was the royal seat until the mid-13th century. Philip II–IV of Spain ruled Portugal 1580–1640 (Iberian Union).

summary.en: Territories of central Italy ruled by the popes as temporal sovereigns, from Pepin the Short's donation of 756 until Italian troops entered Rome on 20 September 1870. Their extent swung widely, from Renaissance warrior-popes to Napoleonic annexation.
summary.zh: 教宗作为世俗君主统治的意大利中部领土，始于756年矮子丕平献土，止于1870年9月20日意大利军队进入罗马。其疆域变化很大，从文艺复兴时期的“战士教宗”到拿破仑时代的吞并，起伏不定。

story.en:
In 754 Pope Stephen II crossed the Alps, the first pope to do so, to ask Pepin the Short for help against the Lombards. Pepin twice defeated King Aistulf and in 756 handed the conquered towns of the exarchate of Ravenna to St Peter. A forged document, the Donation of Constantine, later claimed far wider rights; the humanist Lorenzo Valla showed in 1440 that its Latin could not be from the fourth century.

The popes' hold on their lands was often weak until the Renaissance. Alexander VI's son Cesare Borgia and then Julius II, who led armies in person, made the states a real Italian power, and Julius commissioned the new St Peter's and the Sistine ceiling with its revenues.

Napoleon annexed the states in 1809; restored in 1815, they lost most of their lands to Piedmont-Sardinia in 1860, leaving only Rome and Lazio under French protection. When the French garrison left in 1870, Italian troops breached the Aurelian Walls at Porta Pia. Pius IX declared himself a prisoner in the Vatican, a dispute settled only by the Lateran Treaty of 1929.
story.zh:
754年，教宗斯德望二世越过阿尔卑斯山（教宗中第一人），向矮子丕平求援以对抗伦巴第人。丕平两次击败国王艾斯图尔夫，756年把攻取的拉文纳总督区诸城献给圣彼得。后来一份伪造的《君士坦丁献土》声称教廷拥有更广泛的权利；1440年人文主义者洛伦佐·瓦拉证明其拉丁文不可能出自4世纪。

在文艺复兴以前，教宗对领地的控制往往薄弱。亚历山大六世之子切萨雷·博尔贾以及亲自领兵的尤利乌斯二世使教皇国成为意大利的一大强权，尤利乌斯还用其收入兴建新圣彼得大教堂、委托绘制西斯廷天顶画。

1809年拿破仑吞并教皇国；1815年复国后，1860年大部分领土被皮埃蒙特-撒丁王国吞并，只剩罗马和拉齐奥在法国保护之下。1870年法国驻军撤离，意大利军队在庇亚门攻破奥勒良城墙。庇护九世自称“梵蒂冈的囚徒”，这一争端直到1929年《拉特兰条约》才得以解决。

sources.title: Thomas F. X. Noble, The Republic of St. Peter: The Birth of the Papal State, 680–825 (1984)
David I. Kertzer, Prisoner of the Vatican (2004)

note: Pius IX reigned as pope until 1878; his temporal rule ended in 1870. During the Avignon papacy (1309–1377) the popes resided outside the states.

name.zh: 荷兰共和国（尼德兰联省共和国）

capital.en: The Hague (seat of the States General)

summary.en: Federal republic of seven northern Netherlands provinces that abjured Philip II in 1581 and won recognition at Münster in 1648. Its trading companies, banks and painters made the seventeenth century its Golden Age; French revolutionary armies ended it in 1795.
summary.zh: 尼德兰北部七省组成的联邦共和国，1581年宣布废黜腓力二世，1648年在明斯特获得承认。其贸易公司、银行与画家造就了17世纪的“黄金时代”；1795年法国革命军终结了这一共和国。

story.en:
In July 1581 the States General meeting in The Hague passed the Act of Abjuration, declaring that a prince who oppresses his subjects forfeits his right to rule. They first looked for another monarch, tried the Duke of Anjou and then the Earl of Leicester, and only after 1588 governed themselves as a republic of sovereign provinces.

Power was split between the States, dominated by Holland's merchant regents, and the princes of Orange who served as stadtholders and army commanders. The two clashed repeatedly: Oldenbarnevelt, Land's Advocate of Holland, was executed in 1619 after a quarrel with Maurice, and in the French invasion year of 1672 a mob in The Hague lynched Johan and Cornelis de Witt, bringing William III to power.

The republic of under two million people ran the world's largest merchant fleet, the first stock exchange in Amsterdam and the Dutch East India Company. William III later took the English throne in 1688. Exhausted by wars with Britain and divided between Orangists and Patriots, the republic collapsed when French troops crossed the frozen rivers in January 1795.
story.zh:
1581年7月，在海牙开会的联省议会通过《誓绝法案》，宣布压迫臣民的君主即丧失统治权。他们起初仍在寻找新君主，先后请来安茹公爵和莱斯特伯爵，直到1588年后才以诸省主权共和国的形式自治。

权力分属以荷兰省商人摄政为主的联省议会和担任执政与军队统帅的奥兰治亲王，双方屡生冲突：1619年荷兰省法律顾问奥尔登巴内费尔特在与莫里斯争执后被处死；1672年法军入侵之际，海牙暴民私刑处死约翰与科内利斯·德维特兄弟，威廉三世由此掌权。

这个人口不足两百万的共和国拥有世界最大的商船队、阿姆斯特丹的第一家证券交易所和荷兰东印度公司。威廉三世后于1688年登上英格兰王位。因与英国连年交战而国力耗竭，又分裂为奥兰治派与“爱国者”两派，共和国在1795年1月法军跨过冰封的河流后瓦解。

sources.title: Jonathan I. Israel, The Dutch Republic: Its Rise, Greatness, and Fall 1477–1806 (1995)
Simon Schama, The Embarrassment of Riches (1987)

note: The republic dates from the Act of Abjuration (1581, Wikidata) or from the States General assuming sovereignty (1588). Stadtholders were officers of individual provinces, chiefly Holland and Zeeland; stadtholderless periods 1650–1672 and 1702–1747.

summary.en: Kingdom traditionally dated from Kenneth MacAlpin's rule over Picts and Scots. It kept its independence against England in the wars of Wallace and Robert the Bruce, shared a king with England from 1603, and merged with it into Great Britain in 1707.
summary.zh: 传统上以肯尼思·麦克阿尔平统治皮克特人与苏格兰人为开端的王国。它在华莱士和罗伯特·布鲁斯领导的战争中抵挡英格兰而保持独立，1603年起与英格兰共戴一君，1707年合并为大不列颠。

sources.title: Michael Lynch, Scotland: A New History (1991)
Alex Woolf, From Pictland to Alba, 789–1070 (2007)

note: 843 is the traditional start; the kingdom of Alba emerges in sources around 900. Edinburgh became the usual capital only in the 15th century (earlier Scone, Dunfermline, Perth).

summary.en: Maritime republic whose colonies stretched from the Black Sea (Caffa) to Chios and whose merchants and fleets reached Seville, Lisbon and Flanders; long Venice's rival. From 1528 Andrea Doria's constitution and its bankers' loans to Habsburg Spain made it a financial power until Napoleon turned it into the Ligurian Republic in 1797.
summary.zh: 一个海上共和国，其殖民地从黑海的卡法延伸到希俄斯岛，商人与船队远达塞维利亚、里斯本和佛兰德，长期与威尼斯争雄。1528年起，安德烈亚·多里亚制定的宪制以及银行家对西班牙哈布斯堡的贷款使其成为金融强国，直到1797年拿破仑将其改为利古里亚共和国。

name.zh: 古列尔莫·博卡内格拉（人民首领）
西蒙·博卡内格拉（首任总督）

贾科莫·玛丽亚·布里尼奥莱（末任总督）

sources.title: Steven A. Epstein, Genoa and the Genoese, 958–1528 (1996)
Thomas Allison Kirk, Genoa and the Sea (2005)

note: The 1005 start is conventional (Wikidata); the commune is attested from 1096–1099. Simone Boccanegra was doge 1339–1344 and 1356–1363; Antoniotto Adorno held office four times between 1378 and 1396.

summary.en: Self-governing commune whose wool and banking wealth, and Medici patronage, made it the heart of the Renaissance. Republican institutions survived, often in name only, under the Medici from 1434, with interruptions in 1494–1512 and 1527–1530, until Alessandro de' Medici became duke in 1532.
summary.zh: 一个自治城市公社，羊毛业与银行业的财富以及美第奇家族的赞助使其成为文艺复兴的中心。1434年起美第奇家族掌权，共和制度往往有名无实，期间1494—1512年和1527—1530年曾两度中断，直到1532年亚历山德罗·德·美第奇成为公爵。

name.zh: 萨伏那洛拉（主导城政的布道者）
皮耶罗·索德里尼（终身正义旗手）

sources.title: John M. Najemy, A History of Florence 1200–1575 (2006)
Christopher Hibbert, The Rise and Fall of the House of Medici (1974)

note: The commune's start (1115, death of Countess Matilda) is conventional. The Medici held no formal office before 1532; their entries mark de facto leadership.

summary.en: Republic proclaimed by the National Convention on 22 September 1792 after the fall of the monarchy. It went through the Terror, the Directory and Bonaparte's Consulate, and ended when the Senate proclaimed Napoleon emperor in May 1804.
summary.zh: 君主制倒台后，国民公会于1792年9月22日宣布成立的共和国。它经历恐怖统治、督政府和波拿巴的执政府，1804年5月元老院宣布拿破仑为皇帝，共和国随之结束。

name.zh: 罗伯斯庇尔（救国委员会）
拿破仑·波拿巴（第一执政）

sources.title: William Doyle, The Oxford History of the French Revolution (2nd ed., 2002)

note: The republic had collective executives (Convention committees, Directory, Consulate); the entries are its dominant figures.

summary.en: Napoleon's empire, proclaimed in May 1804. At its height in 1811 it stretched from Hamburg to Rome with satellite kingdoms and allies across Europe; defeat in Russia and at Leipzig led to his abdication in 1814, and Waterloo ended the Hundred Days in 1815.
summary.zh: 1804年5月宣布成立的拿破仑帝国。1811年鼎盛时疆域从汉堡延伸到罗马，并有遍布欧洲的附庸王国与盟邦；在俄国和莱比锡的失败导致他于1814年退位，1815年滑铁卢之战终结了“百日王朝”。

name.zh: 拿破仑二世（仅被宣布，未实际统治）

sources.title: Geoffrey Ellis, The Napoleonic Empire (2nd ed., 2003)

note: The Bourbon Restoration (1814–1815, 1815–1830), July Monarchy and Second Republic (to 1852) are not yet separate records.

summary.en: Republic proclaimed in Paris on 4 September 1870 after Napoleon III's capture at Sedan. It survived the Commune, the Dreyfus affair and the First World War, built a colonial empire and secular schools, and voted itself out of existence in Vichy after the defeat of 1940.
summary.zh: 1870年9月4日拿破仑三世在色当被俘后于巴黎宣布成立的共和国。它经受住巴黎公社、德雷福斯事件和第一次世界大战，建立殖民帝国和世俗学校，1940年战败后在维希投票自行解散。

note: Presidents except Clemenceau, the wartime prime minister. Vichy France (1940–1944) and the Fourth Republic (1946–1958) are not yet separate records.

summary.en: Present French regime, created by Charles de Gaulle's constitution of October 1958 during the Algerian crisis. It gives a strong president, directly elected since 1962, wide powers alongside a prime minister responsible to parliament.
summary.zh: 法国现行政体，由夏尔·戴高乐在阿尔及利亚危机期间推动的1958年10月宪法建立。总统权力强大，自1962年起由直接选举产生，与对议会负责的总理共同执政。

name.zh: 瓦莱里·吉斯卡尔·德斯坦

summary.en: German democracy proclaimed on 9 November 1918 and given a constitution at Weimar in 1919. It survived hyperinflation and putsches but not the Depression: from 1930 presidential emergency cabinets ruled, and Hindenburg appointed Hitler chancellor on 30 January 1933.
summary.zh: 1918年11月9日宣布成立、1919年在魏玛制定宪法的德国民主政体。它挺过了恶性通货膨胀和多次政变，却未能挺过大萧条：1930年起由总统紧急内阁执政，1933年1月30日兴登堡任命希特勒为总理。

summary.en: The one-party dictatorship of Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party, from his appointment as chancellor in 1933 to the unconditional surrender of May 1945. It started the Second World War in Europe and carried out the Holocaust.
summary.zh: 希特勒与纳粹党的一党独裁政权，始于1933年他被任命为总理，止于1945年5月无条件投降。它在欧洲挑起第二次世界大战，并实施了大屠杀。

summary.en: Democratic German state founded on 23 May 1949 in the three western occupation zones under the Basic Law. "West Germany" until 1990, it absorbed the GDR at reunification on 3 October 1990; parliament and government moved to Berlin in 1999.
summary.zh: 1949年5月23日依据《基本法》在西方三个占领区建立的民主德国国家。1990年前通称“西德”，1990年10月3日统一时并入民主德国；1999年议会和政府迁往柏林。

summary.en: Communist state founded on 7 October 1949 in the Soviet occupation zone and ruled by the Socialist Unity Party (SED) with the Stasi secret police. It built the Berlin Wall in 1961; mass protests opened the border in November 1989 and it acceded to the Federal Republic on 3 October 1990.
summary.zh: 1949年10月7日在苏联占领区建立的共产主义国家，由德国统一社会党和秘密警察“斯塔西”统治。1961年修建柏林墙；1989年11月大规模抗议迫使边界开放，1990年10月3日并入联邦德国。

summary.en: Republic chosen by referendum on 2 June 1946, replacing the monarchy; its constitution took effect in 1948. A founder of NATO and the European Communities, it went through the "economic miracle", the terrorism of the "years of lead" and the collapse of its party system in the 1990s.
summary.zh: 1946年6月2日经公民投票取代君主制而成立的共和国，宪法于1948年生效。它是北约与欧洲共同体的创始国之一，经历了“经济奇迹”、“铅之年代”的恐怖主义以及1990年代政党体制的崩溃。

summary.en: Spain under the Bourbon dynasty, which won the throne in the War of the Spanish Succession and centralised the monarchy with the Nueva Planta decrees. Napoleon's invasion (1808–1814) and the loss of the American empire followed; the abdication of Amadeo of Savoy in 1873 brought the First Republic.
summary.zh: 波旁王朝统治下的西班牙，该王朝在西班牙王位继承战争中赢得王位，并以《新基本法令》实现君主集权。此后经历拿破仑入侵（1808—1814年）和美洲帝国的丧失；1873年萨伏依的阿玛迪奥退位，第一共和国随之成立。

summary.en: The restored Bourbon monarchy of Alfonso XII and Alfonso XIII, built by Antonio Cánovas on rigged alternation between Conservatives and Liberals. It lost Cuba and the Philippines in 1898, accepted Primo de Rivera's dictatorship (1923–1930) and fell when the king left after the 1931 municipal elections.

summary.en: Democratic republic proclaimed on 14 April 1931. Its reforms on land, the Church, the army and Catalan autonomy polarised the country; the military rising of July 1936 began the Civil War, and the republic fell when Nationalist troops entered Madrid in March 1939.

summary.en: Personal union of Denmark, Norway and Sweden created at Kalmar in 1397, when Margaret I had her great-nephew Eric of Pomerania crowned king of all three. Swedish nobles repeatedly rebelled; after the Stockholm Bloodbath of 1520 Gustav Vasa led Sweden out of the union in 1523.
summary.zh: 1397年在卡尔马成立的丹麦、挪威、瑞典共主联盟，玛格丽特一世让她的外甥孙波美拉尼亚的埃里克加冕为三国国王。瑞典贵族屡次反叛；1520年斯德哥尔摩惨案后，古斯塔夫·瓦萨于1523年率瑞典退出联盟。

story.en:
Margaret, daughter of the Danish king Valdemar IV and widow of King Haakon VI of Norway, became the regent of Denmark and Norway in the 1380s and was invited by Swedish nobles in 1388 to replace their unpopular German king, Albert of Mecklenburg, whom her army captured in 1389. At Kalmar in June 1397 her great-nephew Eric of Pomerania was crowned king of all three realms, though Margaret kept real power until her death in 1412.

The union treaty was never fully ratified, and Danish kings ruling through Danish and German officials provoked Swedish resistance, beginning with Engelbrekt's rising of 1434. For much of the fifteenth century Sweden was governed by regents of the Sture family.

In November 1520 Christian II, newly crowned in Stockholm, had more than eighty nobles, bishops and burghers executed in the main square on charges of heresy, the Stockholm Bloodbath. The young noble Gustav Eriksson Vasa raised Dalarna against him and was elected king of Sweden on 6 June 1523, now Sweden's national day. Denmark and Norway stayed united until 1814.
story.zh:
玛格丽特是丹麦国王瓦尔德马四世之女、挪威国王哈康六世的遗孀，1380年代成为丹麦和挪威的摄政；1388年瑞典贵族邀请她取代不得人心的德意志籍国王梅克伦堡的阿尔布雷希特，次年她的军队俘获了阿尔布雷希特。1397年6月，她的外甥孙波美拉尼亚的埃里克在卡尔马加冕为三国国王，但实权直到1412年她去世前一直掌握在她手中。

联盟条约从未得到完全批准，丹麦国王通过丹麦和德意志官员治理，激起瑞典人反抗，始于1434年的恩格尔布雷克特起义。15世纪的大部分时间里，瑞典由斯图雷家族的摄政统治。

1520年11月，刚在斯德哥尔摩加冕的克里斯蒂安二世以异端罪名在主广场处决了八十多名贵族、主教和市民，史称“斯德哥尔摩惨案”。青年贵族古斯塔夫·埃里克松·瓦萨发动达拉纳地区起兵反抗，并于1523年6月6日当选瑞典国王，这一天如今是瑞典国庆日。丹麦与挪威的联合则延续到1814年。

summary.en: Sweden's century as a great power, from the accession of Gustavus Adolphus, whose wars won it Ingria and Livonia and whose intervention in the Thirty Years' War led to its German provinces (1648), to the Great Northern War, when Charles XII's defeat at Poltava (1709) and the Treaty of Nystad (1721) ended its dominance.
summary.zh: 瑞典作为大国的一个世纪，始于古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫即位——他的战争为瑞典赢得英格里亚和利沃尼亚，他介入三十年战争又为瑞典在1648年取得德意志领地奠定基础；止于大北方战争——查理十二世在波尔塔瓦战败（1709年）和《尼斯塔德条约》（1721年）终结了瑞典的霸权。

summary.en: The restored Bourbon monarchy of Louis XVIII and Charles X, ruling under the Charter of 1814, a constitution with a two-chamber parliament and a narrow, property-based franchise. Interrupted by Napoleon's Hundred Days in 1815, it fell in the July Revolution of 1830 after Charles X's ordinances curbed the press and dissolved the Chamber.
summary.zh: 路易十八和查理十世复辟的波旁王朝，依据1814年《宪章》统治：设两院制议会，选举权以财产为限，范围很窄。1815年曾被拿破仑的“百日王朝”打断；1830年查理十世颁布敕令限制出版自由、解散议院，引发七月革命，王朝覆灭。

summary.en: The constitutional monarchy of Louis-Philippe, 'King of the French', set up after the July Revolution of 1830. Resting on the wealthy bourgeoisie and a small electorate, it refused electoral reform under Guizot and was overthrown in the February Revolution of 1848.
summary.zh: 1830年七月革命后建立的路易-菲利普“法国人的国王”的君主立宪政体。它依靠富裕的资产阶级和人数很少的选民，在基佐主政时拒绝扩大选举权，1848年被二月革命推翻。

summary.en: Republic proclaimed in February 1848. It introduced universal male suffrage and abolished slavery in the colonies, crushed the workers' June Days rising, and in December 1848 elected Louis-Napoléon Bonaparte president. His coup of 2 December 1851 ended it; he became emperor a year later.
summary.zh: 1848年2月宣告成立的共和国。它实行男性普选，废除殖民地奴隶制，镇压了工人的“六月起义”，并于1848年12月选举路易-拿破仑·波拿巴为总统。1851年12月2日他发动政变终结了共和国，一年后称帝。

summary.en: The empire of Napoleon III, proclaimed on 2 December 1852. It rebuilt Paris under Baron Haussmann, expanded railways, banks and the colonial empire, and fought in Crimea, Italy and Mexico. It collapsed when the emperor was captured at Sedan in the war with Prussia; the republic was proclaimed on 4 September 1870.
summary.zh: 拿破仑三世的帝国，1852年12月2日宣告成立。它在奥斯曼男爵主持下改造巴黎，扩建铁路、银行和殖民帝国，并在克里米亚、意大利和墨西哥作战。普法战争中皇帝在色当被俘，帝国随之崩溃，1870年9月4日共和国宣告成立。

summary.en: The authoritarian 'French State' of Marshal Pétain, created when the National Assembly, meeting at Vichy on 10 July 1940 after the defeat, voted him full powers by 569 to 80. It collaborated with Nazi Germany, passed antisemitic laws and helped deport about 76,000 Jews from France, and collapsed with the liberation in August 1944.
summary.zh: 贝当元帅的威权“法兰西国”。1940年战败后，国民议会于7月10日在维希以569票对80票授予他全权，由此建立。它与纳粹德国合作，颁布反犹法律，协助从法国驱逐约7.6万名犹太人，1944年8月随法国解放而瓦解。

summary.en: Parliamentary republic founded under the constitution approved by referendum in October 1946. It rebuilt the economy, joined NATO and helped found the European communities, but had some twenty governments in twelve years and was broken by the colonial wars in Indochina and Algeria; the crisis of May 1958 brought back de Gaulle.
summary.zh: 依据1946年10月全民公决通过的宪法建立的议会制共和国。它重建经济，加入北约并参与创建欧洲共同体，但十二年间更换了约二十届政府，又被印度支那和阿尔及利亚的殖民战争拖垮；1958年5月危机使戴高乐重新执政。

summary.en: Republic proclaimed by the Cortes on 11 February 1873 after King Amadeo I abdicated. Torn by the Carlist war, the federalist cantonal revolts and war in Cuba, it went through four presidents in eleven months; General Pavía's coup of January 1874 and a pronunciamiento at Sagunto in December 1874 restored the Bourbons under Alfonso XII.
summary.zh: 1873年2月11日国王阿马德奥一世退位后，议会宣布成立共和国。它饱受卡洛斯战争、联邦派各州起义和古巴战争的困扰，十一个月内换了四位总统；1874年1月帕维亚将军发动政变，同年12月萨贡托的军事宣言使阿方索十二世复辟波旁王朝。

summary.en: The composite state of the House of Savoy, which was made to exchange Sicily for Sardinia (Treaty of London 1718, possession in 1720) and ruled Piedmont, Savoy, Nice and, from 1815, Genoa from Turin. Under Charles Albert's 1848 Statute and Cavour's leadership it led Italian unification and became the Kingdom of Italy in 1861.
summary.zh: 萨伏依家族的复合国家。它被迫以西西里换取撒丁岛（1718年《伦敦条约》，1720年接管），从都灵统治皮埃蒙特、萨伏依、尼斯，1815年起又统治热那亚。在卡洛·阿尔贝托1848年颁布的《宪章》和加富尔的领导下，它主导了意大利统一，1861年成为意大利王国。

summary.en: The Bourbon kingdom formed in December 1816 when Ferdinand merged his crowns of Naples and Sicily into one state, the largest in pre-unification Italy. Shaken by revolts in 1820, 1848 and Sicilian separatism, it fell to Garibaldi's Thousand in 1860; Francis II surrendered at Gaeta in February 1861.
summary.zh: 1816年12月斐迪南将那不勒斯和西西里两顶王冠合并为一国而成立的波旁王朝王国，是统一前意大利最大的国家。它先后经历1820年、1848年的革命和西西里分离运动，1860年被加里波第的“千人团”攻占；1861年2月弗朗切斯科二世在加埃塔投降。

summary.en: The Oldenburg realm of Denmark, Norway, Iceland, the Faroes, Greenland and Schleswig-Holstein, ruled from Copenhagen. Christian III reduced Norway to a dependency in 1536–37 and imposed Lutheranism; Frederick III made the crown absolute and hereditary in 1660. After siding with Napoleon, Denmark ceded Norway to Sweden by the Treaty of Kiel in 1814.
summary.zh: 由哥本哈根统治的奥尔登堡王朝国家，包括丹麦、挪威、冰岛、法罗群岛、格陵兰和石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因。克里斯蒂安三世于1536—1537年把挪威降为附属国并推行路德宗；腓特烈三世于1660年确立世袭专制王权。因站在拿破仑一边，丹麦在1814年《基尔条约》中把挪威割让给瑞典。
